name: TSDF Volume Integration with Uncertainty Weighting
definition: A volumetric integration method that fuses depth maps into a Truncated Signed Distance Function (TSDF) volume using per-pixel weights derived from depth uncertainty (inverse standard deviation), supporting both standard uniform weighting and uncertainty-based weighting (Sigma-Fusion).
summary: TSDF Volume Integration with Uncertainty Weighting fuses depth maps into a TSDF volume by weighting pixels based on their depth uncertainty, down-weighting unreliable measurements to improve reconstruction quality in noisy SLAM pipelines.
